title: Departments with more than 2 employees
prompt: Return departments that have more than 2 employees, along with the count as a column named cnt.
setup_sql: CREATE TABLE staff2 (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, name TEXT, department TEXT); INSERT INTO staff2 VALUES (1,'A','Eng'),(2,'B','Eng'),(3,'C','Sales'),(4,'D','Eng'),(5,'E','Sales'),(6,'F','HR');
reference_sql: SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM staff2 GROUP BY department HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;
